title: Quality Control Associate
description:
Location: 3520 Laird Road Mississauga, L5L 5Z7

Shift: Morning and/or Afternoon and/or Night including weekends & holidays

About the Role

Job Overview

As a Quality Control Associate you will take a hands-on approach to maintaining and continuously improving our product quality control processes. Reporting to the Supervisor, Quality Control , you will play a key role in ensuring our Production Associates have all essential high-quality ingredients required to make delicious and safe  meal kits for our customers.

What you will be doing:

• Receive inbounding and inventory SKUs from the Warehouse department and conduct quality control inspections to ensure products adhere to required specifications.

• Work closely with the Warehouse team to achieve quality targets, in addition to performing regular inspections on packaged products for lot codes.

• Respond to Quality and/or BBD issues on the production lines

• Maintain clear and concise communication with the Operations, Procurement, and Logistics teams; in cases of product non-conformance, alongside maintaining a photo database of product non-conformances.

• Lead production associates for ingredient sorting.

• Perform quality control inspections on work-in-progress and finished products to ensure products meet Company Standards.

• Ensure accuracy and efficiency at designated ship-out stations, and complete logs and records as required.

• Work in compliance with OH&S acts and regulations.

• Use personal protective and safety equipment and clothing as directed by the employer and report workplace hazards and dangers to the supervisor or employer.

• Conduct environmental monitoring and equipment calibration verification, (Environmental sampling & ATP swabbing)

• Provide support to FSQA Supervisor.

• Perform Quality Assurance inspections as they pertain to Finished Product, Raw Materials, Water and Cleaning & Sanitation.

• Perform sensory on shelf stable raw materials.

• Monitor PRPs and PC's.

• Ensure all Out of Spec findings, as they pertain to the aforementioned, are addressed through the procedures as they pertain to "Deviation, Corrective Action & Preventative Measures", "Food Safety Assessment" and "Product Holds".

• Conduct internal inspection on a periodic basis, i.e. GMP audits and pre operational inspections.

• Ensure water samples are sent out to Accredited Laboratories on a periodic basis for analytical testing. 

• Provide support to the management teams in troubleshooting and resolving problems in the Production Process.

• Ensure GMPs and Management of allergens is followed as per procedures.

• Ensure spillages are cleaned up immediately to eliminate the potential for cross contamination of allergens.

• Other duties as assigned

At a minimum, you have: 

• Post-secondary education in Biological, Chemical or Food Sciences diploma

• 6 Months to 1 year experience working in QC/QA in a food processing, manufacturing or service industry

• Willing and able to push, pull, and lift up to 50lbs

• Has experience with standing for prolonged periods of time including regular bending, twisting and walking

• Understanding the Safe Food for Canadians Regulations and GFSI schemes

• Willing and able to work in a refrigerated environment (0°C to 4°C) 

• Ability to communicate in English, both verbal and written

• Familiar with MS Office, Google Apps and comfortable learning new technologies. 

• Ability to prioritize, remain calm and alert while multitasking in a fast-paced and deadline oriented environment. 

• Ability to work independently and within a team environment, in addition to having strong interpersonal skills. 

• Level 1 First Aid is considered an asset.

What you’ll get in return:

• Competitive salary and health benefits

• Shift premiums are available for afternoon and overnight shifts

title: Power Studies Engineer (PSCAD)
description:
Location : US, Remote
Employment Type : Full-Time
Industry : Mission-Critical Facilities, Data Centers
Travel : Required as per project needs

Role Summary:

Ehvert Mission Critical, a business unit within Salas O’Brien, is seeking a highly experienced Power Studies Engineer to join our team and support the analysis and design of complex electrical power systems for hyperscale and AI data centers across the United States. This is a remote role within an innovative, international engineering firm recognized for its cutting-edge work in mission-critical infrastructure.

As a Power Studies Engineer, you will play a key role in evaluating electrical system performance, reliability, and resiliency through advanced power system studies and modeling. You will work closely with electrical engineering teams, utilities, and project stakeholders to develop solutions for high-density AI and mission-critical facilities where system reliability and uptime are paramount.

This role offers the opportunity to work on high-impact projects for global clients in the hyperscale data center market while advancing your career in a dynamic and collaborative environment.

What We Offer:

• Experience in a high-tech industry within an international company

• Unique, cutting-edge data center projects

• Comprehensive training and professional development opportunities

• Supportive management and a dynamic team environment

• Career growth potential

• Competitive salary

• Competitive benefits package: Health insurance (Medical, HSA & FSA, Dental, Vision), Life insurance, Short-term and long-term disability, many other benefits, including PTO, retirement plan

• Stock ownership / synthetic equity options

• Work from home

What You Will Do:

• Perform power system studies including load flow, short circuit, protective device coordination, arc flash, grounding, power quality, harmonic analysis, transient analysis, and reliability studies.

• Develop and maintain electrical system models using PSCAD , ETAP, SKM, EasyPower, or similar software platforms.

• Perform electromagnetic transient (EMT) studies to evaluate system behavior during switching events, faults, utility disturbances, and large load changes.

• Analyze the impact of high-density AI load characteristics, and mission-critical loads on utility, emergency generators, and facility electrical infrastructure.

• Support utility interconnection studies and coordinate with utility providers on service requirements and system performance.

• Evaluate system reliability, redundancy strategies, contingency scenarios, and power system resiliency.

• Prepare technical reports, engineering calculations, study documentation, and recommendations.

• Collaborate with electrical design teams on medium-voltage systems, substations, standby generation, UPS systems, mechanical system electrical load characteristics, and utility service infrastructure.

• Participate in design coordination meetings with clients, consultants, utilities, and project stakeholders.

• Support commissioning activities and provide technical guidance during project execution.

• Review engineering deliverables for technical accuracy and compliance with applicable standards.

What We Expect:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering from a recognized university.

• Minimum of 8-15 years of experience in power systems engineering, utility engineering, substations, transmission and distribution, industrial facilities, renewable energy, or mission-critical infrastructure.

• Experience performing power system studies, including transient, harmonic, and grounding analysis, is required.

• Proficiency with PSCAD is required .

• Experience with ETAP, SKM, EasyPower, PowerFactory, CYME, or similar power system analysis software.

• Strong understanding of electrical power systems, utility infrastructure, substations, protective relaying, and system reliability.

• Experience with utility interconnections and medium-voltage

title: Lead Product Manager, Customer Portal
description:
About Customer Portal

Customer Portal exists to make Veriff 's product sell itself. The Portal serves two purposes. It allows our customers to operate Veriff products - setting up and configuring products, consulting verification session details, reporting issues. And it is a privileged surface for customers to discover, try, buy and expand through a seamless self-serve experience, connecting product usage, onboarding and growth in one place. It unites forces with GTM to automate acquisition, upsell, cross-sell and retention, with end-to-end ownership of the customer persona. The area is evolving fast. What began as a self-serve growth surface (Station) is becoming the customer-facing window into Veriff 's accuracy and fraud advantage for our largest enterprise customers.

The shape of this role

This is an IC-first leadership role, and the first genuine step into product leadership - distinct from a strong senior IC. At first you will lead through craft, authority and influence. You own the strategy, discovery, roadmap and delivery for your product area.

As you refine the strategic themes for this large product, we expect you to propose the team configuration needed to support our growth and company objectives. That will move you progressively from IC to manager, while retaining hands-on ownership of at least one part of the Customer Portal area in the mid-term. We will deliberately assess for both the IC craft bar and the latent management capability, because the role is designed to traverse the line.

What you will do

• Own the product strategy and roadmap for the Customer Portal area, tied explicitly to Veriff 's commercial model and revenue drivers.

• Run disciplined, continuous discovery with customers, and translate it into well-defined problem statements and a sequenced roadmap.

• Make transparent prioritisation and trade-off calls across product ambition, technical sustainability and business urgency - especially where capability gaps mean we cannot do everything at once.

• Define success metrics before building, and hold the team accountable to outcomes, not output.

• Partner as a credible peer to Engineering, GTM, Fraud Ops and Design. Be the connective tissue that turns internal expertise into a customer-facing product.

• Own launch as a discipline from the start - internal platform releases and external GTM - not a milestone at the end.

• Set and uphold the product-craft bar. Mentor PMs and, in time, build and lead the team.

• Champion AI internally, implementing new best practices for faster product discovery and delivery.

Who you are

You are a product leader who has earned authority through the quality of your thinking rather than a title.

You have owned a product area end-to-end

• From strategy through discovery, delivery and launch. You are equally comfortable in the messy front end of a problem and in the discipline of shipping.

• You are looking for the step where your impact starts to come through others, and you are excited that this role begins as an individual leader and grows into managing a team - not the other way around.

You think commercially

• You instinctively connect what you build to how the business grows, and you explain the “why” behind a product bet in terms of revenue, retention and customer trust, not just features and flows.

You run discovery as a continuous discipline

• You get close to customers, including demanding enterprise accounts, and you can tell the difference between what they ask for and what they actually need.

• You turn that into sharp problem statements and a phased roadmap where every step delivers a real customer outcome.

You prioritise ruthlessly and transparently

• When there are more good ideas than capacity, you make the hard calls about what not to do, and you can articulate the reasoning.

• You define success before you build. When something goes wrong, you own it without deflection and change how you work as a result.

title: Senior Product and Project Manager
description:

hireworks is building a community of top talent in key international markets by unlocking unparalleled access to positions at leading U.S. based companies. As your employer, hireworks will ensure you have a seamless interview, onboarding, and employee experience - providing ongoing support and resources along the way. Established in 2023, hireworks is forging corp-to-corp relationships with leading U.S. based organizations looking to grow their teams with best-in-class talent around the world. Working with hireworks means unlocking access to a network of local peers and mentors and career opportunities through our client network.
About our client
An AI engineering and consulting firm that builds serious, production-grade systems for companies ready to operationalize AI across their business. No gimmicks, no stopping at prototypes: custom AI that integrates directly into operations and drives measurable results.
They automate high-effort workflows, launch AI-powered product lines, and turn complex internal data into structured, usable assets-from custom-trained models and retrieval pipelines to systems that reason across vast datasets, technical documents, and domain-specific logic. Their clients span engineering, defense, financial services, and healthcare.
About the role:
We are seeking a Senior Technical Product Manager to lead the delivery of an enterprise AI knowledge and data platform for a premier engineering client. In this role, you will bridge technical solutioning with hands-on delivery execution: partnering with leadership to scope Statements of Work (SOWs), authoring clear technical requirements, running sprint cadences with backend and AI engineers, and steering core API integrations between our AI platform and external client systems.
What you will own:

•
SOW Scoping & Authoring: Partner with practice leadership and client stakeholders to identify upcoming work streams, define scope, and author clear, technically viable SOW drafts.

•
Delivery & Sprint Execution: Own the delivery lifecycle post-signature. Translate SOW objectives into epics, technical specs, user stories, and strict acceptance criteria while managing day-to-day sprint velocity.

•
Stakeholder & Scope Governance: Act as the primary technical counterpart for client engineering leads. Navigate scope evolution, govern change requests, and maintain clear delivery roadmaps.

•
Backend & API Integration Oversight: Steer the interface between core AI knowledge systems and client software platforms, ensuring reliable API contracts, data fidelity, and low-latency query performance.

•
Delivery Rhythms: Establish delivery visibility, milestones, tracking dashboards, and lightweight agile rituals across the engineering pod.

Responsibilities:

•
Lead Day-to-Day Engineering Execution: Run agile ceremonies-backlog grooming, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives-unblocking backend and AI engineers to keep delivery on schedule.

•
Author Technical Requirements: Write detailed requirements, system workflows, API contracts, and QA/acceptance criteria for backend-heavy data ingestion, model retrieval, and third-party software integration.

•
Govern Scope with Rigor: Proactively identify delivery drift; triage and negotiate client change requests with diplomatic firmness to protect timelines and quality.

•
Identify Account Expansion: Bring a consulting mindset to client interactions, identifying operational bottlenecks and framing follow-on technical SOWs.

•
Facilitate Technical Alignment: Run high-impact client working sessions, lead technical demos, and deliver structured status updates to client leadership.

Required experience:

•
8+ Years in Technical Product Management: Proven background as a Senior, Principal, or Staff TPM delivering complex backend, platform, or data-infrastructure systems.

•
Relentless Project Management & Detail: Strong, hands-on experience driving day-to-day agile execution, milestone tracking, and rigo

As a company, we are committed to upholding our core values of Belonging, Integrity, Service, Accountability, and Curiosity. We are seeking a hands-on, tech-savvy Accounting Manager to lead accounting operations, financial reporting, and month-end close activities while ensuring accuracy, compliance, and operational excellence. Reporting to the Controller, this role will manage and develop a small accounting team, strengthen internal controls, drive process improvements, and help scale the finance function through automation and AI-enabled solutions. The ideal candidate combines strong technical accounting expertise with a proactive, high-ownership mindset and a passion for leveraging technology to improve efficiency and support company growth.

Responsibilities:

• Lead accounting operations and financial reporting, including GL, AP, and the month-end close, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and US GAAP compliance.

• Coach and inspire team members, manage and mentor accounting team consisting of one senior accountant and two accountants, fostering a culture of ownership and accountability.

• Drive and continuously streamline the month-end close process, proactively identifying opportunities for automation, efficiency, scalability, and operational effectiveness.

• Establish and enforce internal controls for the month-end close by building robust approval workflows and ensuring comprehensive documentation.

• Oversee balance sheet reconciliations, taking ownership of reviewing current balances and resolving outstanding historical items.

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Vinted Pay
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will be responsible for building and running the verification systems behind Vinted Pay: identity verification (document and biometric checks), electronic KYC (identity and address matching against external data sources) and bank account verification (Confirmation of Payee and Verification of Payee). These checks answer one question for millions of members: "is this person who they say they are, and is this really their bank account?" Every onboarding, balance activation and payout in Vinted Pay passes through them.

You will join Verifications, a team in the Vinted Pay domain made up of 3-4 backend engineers, an engineering manager (your reporting line), a product manager and a decision scientist. The team is young and the service is still taking shape: verification logic is being extracted from older Ruby services into a single Go service that is becoming the source of truth for every verification a member has ever done, and we are making verification resilient to provider outages instead of dependent on any one vendor. This is architectural work with direct product and compliance impact, not just feature delivery.

Problems arrive ambiguous. Engineers here aren't handed specs - they work out what's actually needed together with product and compliance, align it across teams, and build it.

In this position, you’ll 

• Work in a compact team where nobody owns just one corner: engineers deliberately move between identity verification, eKYC and bank verification, so over time you'll know the whole domain, not a slice of it.

• Build and own third-party integrations end-to-end: the client, the callbacks, the durable Temporal workflow that drives a verification to a final decision even when the provider never calls back, the dashboards and SLA alerts, and the shared channel with the vendor when something is wrong on their side.

• Design for provider failure: build the provider router that spreads traffic across providers by weight, tracks provider health, remembers what failed for a member and reroutes their retry, so that one provider outage no longer means a member can't verify.

• Run A/B tests between providers to decide where traffic should go, and roll verification rules out to new markets.

• Own topics end-to-end: from an ambiguous requirement to a written technical plan in the repository, through cross-team alignment, implementation, rollout behind feature flags, and monitoring in production.

• Handle personal data with care: PII

title: Senior ML Engineer - Email Security (remote work)
description:
CloudLinux is a global remote-first company. We are driven by our principles: do the right thing, employees first, we are remote first, and we deliver high-volume, low-cost Linux infrastructure and security products that help companies to increase the efficiency of their operations. Every person on our team supports each other and does what we can to ensure we all are successful.
Check out our website for more information:
CloudLinux Inc. develops the Imunify family of security products , designed to protect hosting environments from a wide range of cyber threats. One of these solutions is Imunify Email , an email security product that protects hosting servers against spam, phishing, and other email-based threats.
Imunify Email filters mail on about 5,000 hosting servers. Today the filter is rspamd with rules and a scoring model we train in-house. We are replacing it with a transformer we trained ourselves that runs on the customer's own CPU in under 100 MB and already beats rspamd at every operating point we measured. We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our team and work alongside the engineer currently responsible for both the existing spam-filtering pipeline and the new ML model. Together, you will drive the development, improvement, and production rollout of our email security technology.
What you will do:

• Train, evaluate, and release spam-detection models: build the corpus, pick the threshold, read the precision/recall report, decide ship or retrain.

• Build the production side of the new engine in Go: the inference service, the mail-filter integration, the tokenizer, the streaming message parser.

• Fix detection quality end to end, from a customer's "this phishing got through" to a rule, a corpus fix, or a retrain, with the false-positive cost weighed against the catch.

• Keep the corpus tooling and training infrastructure running.

• Review and approve classifier, rule, and model changes, so no release waits on one person.

• Answer partner engineers who ask why a message scored the way it did.

• Write specs, handbooks, and post-mortems. That is how this team transfers knowledge.

Your first six months:

•
Month 1: you ship a rule-model release on your own.

•
Month 3: your first piece of the new engine is merged and running on staging.

•
Month 6: a model release goes out while the principal engineer is away.

Requirements
What you bring:

•
5+ years of shipping detection or classification systems where false positives have a cost you had to defend: anti-spam, anti-phishing, anti-malware, fraud, abuse.

•
You have taken at least one ML classifier to production yourself: corpus construction, threshold selection, error analysis.

•
Hands-on transformer training in PyTorch: tokenizers, masked-language pre-training, fine-tuning, ONNX export, CPU inference measurement.

•
Linux, shell, and Python on shared servers and a shared GPU.

• Daily usage of AI coding agents and tools.

•
English at upper-Intermediate (B2) level or higher , with particularly strong written communication skills for technical documentation, specifications, and code reviews. Your specs and merge-request descriptions count as much as your code.

It is a strong plus if you have:

•
Email internals: SMTP, MIME, transfer encodings, SPF / DKIM / DMARC, how Exim, Postfix, and Dovecot handle mail to a filter.

• Experience in creating embedded models

•
Go or Rust for systems code: parsers, streaming, memory budgets, concurrency.

• rspamd or SpamAssassin internals: rules, composites, Lua plugins, mass-check scoring.

• Multi-million-sample corpora, labelling pipelines, annotator tooling.

• Small models for constrained hardware: quantization, distillation, latency budgets.

• LLM-based labelers or validators for scaling annotation.

• Hosting panels: cPanel, Plesk, DirectAdmin.

Benefits
What's in it for you?

• Interesting and challenging projects.

title: Senior Software Engineer, CUDA Rust Core Libraries
description:
NVIDIA ’s accelerated computing platform is foundational to modern HPC and AI. At the center of this platform are CUDA Core Libraries that enable developers to build fast, reliable, and scalable GPU-accelerated software. We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to develop the Rust experience for CUDA Core Libraries. You will design safe, idiomatic Rust APIs for GPU computing while integrating closely with native C/C++ components. You will join the team building the foundational libraries, algorithms, and language/runtime infrastructure that make CUDA a speed-of-light experience for developers and AI coding agents alike.

What you’ll be doing:

• Design and implement idiomatic Rust libraries and APIs for foundational CUDA functionality and GPU algorithms.

• Build safe Rust abstractions over native CUDA and C/C++ interfaces.

• Develop and maintain the C/C++ components required to support Rust-facing functionality.

• Establish safe and efficient interoperability between Rust and C/C++, including interfaces that support downstream Python integration.

• Optimize performance across Rust, native C/C++, and GPU execution boundaries.

• Own features end-to-end: design, implementation, testing, profiling, benchmarking, documentation, packaging, release, and maintenance.

• Improve the Rust developer experience through examples, diagnostics, build integration, compatibility testing, CI, and collaboration with C/C++, Python, compiler, and runtime engineers.

• Work with users to investigate and resolve issues related to safety, correctness, usability, compatibility, and performance.

• BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.

• 12 + years of relevant software development experience.

• Strong production programming skills in Rust and C/C++, with deep understanding of Rust ownership, lifetimes, traits, generics, concurrency, and unsafe code.

• Experience developing systems libraries, runtime components, and developer-facing APIs.

• Practical knowledge of foreign-function interfaces and integrating Rust with C/C++ software.

• Solid understanding of systems software concepts, including performance, concurrency, and API design.

• Experience with parallel, heterogeneous, or GPU programming.

• Experience contributing to production or open-source software, including testing, profiling, benchmarking, packaging, and code review.

• Ability to work independently, define scope, and drive complex projects to completion.

• Strong written communication skills and ability to work effectively in large, multi-language codebases (Rust, C/C++, build systems, toolchains, CI).

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Strong understanding of CPU/GPU architecture and performance optimization, with hands-on experience in GPU-accelerated stacks (CUDA C++/Python, PyTorch, JAX, Numba, CuPy, or similar).

• Proficiency with modern C++ and GPU libraries such as Thrust, CUB, and libcudacxx.

• Experience with compiler infrastructure and tooling, including LLVM, Clang, or MLIR.

• Experience designing safe Rust abstractions over low-level or asynchronous systems, including exposure to Python interoperability.

• Demonstrated interest in developer tools, library design, and improving developer productivity

title: Head of Finance
description:
📊 Bouw aan finance bij een organisatie die hard groeit én impact maakt in de zorg.

Hoe zorg je dat een organisatie die haar omzet dit jaar naar verwachting meer dan verdubbelt, financieel in control blijft én klaar is voor de volgende groeifase? Dat is de uitdaging voor de Head of Finance bij Attendi .

Attendi ontwikkelt slimme, AI-gedreven software voor de zorg. De technologie verwerkt maandelijks ruim één miljoen rapportages voor zorgprofessionals . Het doel? Minder tijd achter het scherm en meer oprechte aandacht voor de cliënt. Met circa 25 medewerkers en ambitieuze groeiplannen is Attendi volop in ontwikkeling.

Jouw opdracht?
Je bouwt aan een financiële organisatie die de groei aankan. Je zorgt voor betrouwbare cijfers, efficiënte processen en grip op kosten en opbrengsten. Je professionaliseert de financiële afdeling, geeft leiding aan twee financecollega’s en bent een belangrijke sparringpartner voor de directie en het managementteam.

Eerst breng je structuur, controle en financiële processen stevig op orde. Vervolgens verschuift je focus steeds meer naar business control: je verbetert managementinformatie, analyseert rendement en adviseert over investeringen en efficiency.

Waarom deze rol eruit springt:
→ Directe invloed: je maakt deel uit van het MT en rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de directie.
→ Bouwen én adviseren: je brengt finance op orde en ontwikkelt de functie verder richting business control.
→ Groei van dichtbij: je helpt een ambitieuze organisatie financieel klaar te maken voor de volgende fase.
→ Technologie met betekenis: jouw werk ondersteunt een organisatie die zorgprofessionals meer tijd wil geven voor hun cliënten.
→ Ruimte voor initiatief: korte lijnen, een hoog tempo en de vrijheid om de financiële organisatie zelfstandig verder vorm te geven.

Daar staat een aantrekkelijk pakket tegenover: € 90.000 tot € 110.000 salaris , een goede pensioenregeling, een ClassPass-lidmaatschap en opleidingsbudget. Je werkt hybride, met minimaal drie dagen per week op kantoor.

We zoeken een financeprofessional met een hbo- of wo-achtergrond, bijvoorbeeld Finance & Control of Bedrijfseconomie, leidinggevende ervaring en kennis van procesoptimalisatie en control. Ervaring bij een SaaS-bedrijf of scale-up is een pré.

Ben jij klaar om finance niet alleen te beheersen, maar ook naar een hoger niveau te brengen?

title: Product Manager (CMC expertise)
description:
Docuvera builds technology that supports the highly regulated pharmaceutical industry, where quality, trust, and compliance genuinely matter. Our people help shape the future of digital content in life sciences, so let us tell you more about what we do at Docuvera , why we do it, and what it means for you.
About Docuvera

Our story
Docuvera is the industry leader in governed, structured content authoring for the life sciences industry and as a pioneer in this space, we are proud to support top global Pharma companies. Born out of Author-it in 2017, Docuvera is now a member of the cormeo family of companies, an exciting step that strengthens our global reach and long-term growth.
Our mission
We are on a mission to help our customers harness the power of digital innovation, accelerating their ability to safely get their life changing products to market faster.
For our customers, Docuvera empowers them to drive digital transformation in how they manage their content. Docuvera turns their content into small, reusable components (building blocks). A component is written and approved once, then reused confidently and consistently across many documents, projects, and regions.
For our team, it means delivering real world impact through ground-breaking solutions to technically complex problems.
About the role
The part you'll play
We're seeking a Product Manager who can bring CMC expertise. As a Product Manager, you’ll be responsible for executing Docuvera ’s product strategy, working closely with functional leads in Engineering, Sales, and Services to dive deep and solve customer pain points. Our customer-centric philosophy extends across everything we do. We work to translate customer, market, and business needs into clear, prioritised product requirements that guide the ongoing development of Docuvera ’s services. Working closely with our customers and internal delivery teams, the role helps shape practical, user-focused solutions and supports their successful delivery through an iterative, agile approach.

• Wrangling and defining context, checking scope and requirement, ensure problem statement and solution are building the platform.

• Support the collection, assessment, and prioritization of customer requirements for future versions of Docuvera services.

• Gather input from customer interactions, internal stakeholders, competitive analysis, and market research to inform product decisions.

• Collaborate with Product Management peers to help define and refine the user experience for Docuvera services.

• Assist in defining business and functional requirements for product enhancements (e.g., writing user stories or use cases).

• Break larger product ideas into well-defined, incremental features that can be delivered iteratively.

• Create and maintain product documentation, specifications, and planning artifacts as needed.

• Work with engineers to review and validate user experience designs, including participating in usability testing.

• Collaborate with our Tech and Engineering teams to support agile delivery, including backlog grooming and sprint planning.

• Communicate product updates and feature details internally and, when appropriate, with customers and other external stakeholders.

Why it matters
You’ll know, and we’ll know, this role is successful when you consistently focus the team on what matters most: turning validated customer insight and clear business priorities into well-scoped, incremental product outcomes that reduce customer pain and move the business forward. Success looks like a prioritized roadmap and backlog that reflect strategic trade-offs, repeatable discovery and validation practices that reduce risk before build, crisp requirements engineering trusts, and reliable, timely releases that close customer pain points. Equally important is how you deliver: you build trust internally and externally, lift others, bring calm and clarity through change, and model the judgment and accountability we value.

title: Senior Data Scientist, Fraud
locationText: New York, New York, United States
description:
Hi, we're Oscar. We're hiring a Senior Data Scientist, Fraud to join our Data Team.

Oscar is the first health insurance company built around a full stack technology platform and a relentless focus on serving our members. We started Oscar in 2012 to create the kind of health insurance company we would want for ourselves-one that behaves like a doctor in the family.

About the role:

Oscar's data team is focused on pushing our understanding of the complex landscape of the healthcare and insurance business. Insurance companies sit on a trove of data that is both broad and deep-spanning financial claims, clinical medical records, and rich product interaction data from our members. The Senior Data Scientist, Fraud will help shape Oscar’s fraud data science capabilities and partner with the Medical Economics team and Special Investigations Unit (SIU) to turn Oscar’s data into investigative leads and tools that uncover potential fraud and reduce avoidable medical costs.

As a Senior Data Scientist on this team, you will partner closely with stakeholders to understand business challenges and identify opportunities for data science to drive impact. You will independently manage stakeholder relationships for your projects, translate business needs into technical solutions, and contribute to the fraud data science roadmap.

You will own projects end-to-end-scoping problems with stakeholders, designing the technical approach, implementing pipelines and models, validating outputs, and iterating after launch. Beyond individual projects, you will contribute to the team’s technical direction and mentor junior data scientists.

You will report to the Director, Data Science.

Work Location: This position is based in our New York City office, requiring a hybrid work schedule with 3 days of in-office work per week. Thursdays are a required in-office day for team meetings and events, while your other two office days are flexible to suit your schedule. #LI-Hybrid

Pay Transparency: The base pay for this role is: $163,944 - $215,176 per year. You are also eligible for employee benefits, participation in Oscar's unlimited vacation program, company equity grants and annual performance bonuses.

Responsibilities:

• Design, build, and maintain data pipelines, machine learning models, and analytical tools supporting Oscar’s fraud detection and prevention efforts.

• Partner closely with SIU and Medical Economics to understand business needs, translate them into data science solutions, and independently manage stakeholder relationships for your projects.

• Own projects end-to-end, including problem definition, technical design, implementation, validation, and ongoing evaluation and improvement.

• Interact and collaborate closely with data and business counterparts across functional areas

• Work with your team and manager to identify opportunities and contribute to the fraud data science roadmap and longer-term technical direction.

• Provide mentorship and technical guidance to junior data scientists.

• Compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.

• Other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

• 4+ years of experience in data science or another quantitative technical field, which may include academia.

• 3+ years of experience using SQL and Python to query, manipulate, and analyze data.

• 3+ years experience building data models, using more advanced analytics methods, statistical modeling, and/or data processing.

• Experience applying supervised or unsupervised machine learning techniques, such as predictive modeling, anomaly detection, clustering, or graph/network analysis, to identify potential fraud in healthcare, insurance, financial services, or other industries.

Bonus points:

• Experience analyzing healthcare claims, provider billing patterns, or medical and pharmacy utilization data.

This is an authentic Oscar Health job opportunity.

title: High Ticket Closer | Stock Market & Trading Education
description:
Help people take the next step toward financial education and wealth-building.

ABOUT CURVION BLUE

At Curvion Blue, we help some of the fastest-growing coaching, education, consulting, and business opportunity brands scale their revenue through world-class sales talent.

We believe some of the best sales professionals in the world are underutilized because they're selling the wrong offers, in the wrong environments, with the wrong leadership.

Our mission is simple: deploy the right seller into the right revenue ecosystem.

POSITION OVERVIEW

We're looking for experienced High Ticket Closers with a background in financial education, stock market education, trading, investing, or wealth-building sales.

In this role, you'll work with prospects who have expressed interest in learning how to navigate the financial markets, develop their investing knowledge, and explore opportunities to build long-term wealth.

You'll conduct high-level sales conversations, uncover each prospect's goals and motivations, understand their current challenges, and communicate the value of premium educational programs.

This isn't an entry-level closing opportunity. We're looking for proven sales professionals who understand how to sell high-ticket financial education offers and can confidently navigate conversations involving money, investing, financial goals, and personal aspirations.

You should be comfortable leading consultative sales conversations, handling sophisticated objections, and helping qualified prospects make confident purchasing decisions.

YOU SHOULD APPLY IF

- You have previous experience closing high-ticket offers in the financial education, stock market, trading, investing, or wealth-building space.

- You've sold premium programs, memberships, mentorships, or educational products related to financial markets.

- You've consistently closed deals of $5,000+.

- You understand the psychology of selling financial education and can communicate value without making unrealistic promises.

- You're highly skilled at discovery, objection handling, and consultative selling.

- You can confidently navigate conversations about money, financial goals, and investment education.

- You thrive in performance-driven sales environments.

- You take ownership of your numbers, pipeline, and personal performance.

YOU SHOULD NOT APPLY IF

- You've never sold high-ticket offers in the financial education, trading, investing, or wealth-building space.

- Your only closing experience is in fitness, insurance, automotive, or traditional retail sales.

- You've primarily sold low-ticket products or transactional services.

- You rely heavily on scripts rather than understanding the prospect and leading the conversation.

- You're uncomfortable discussing financial goals and investment-related educational products.

- You need constant oversight or motivation to hit your targets.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- Consistently converting qualified appointments into enrolled clients.

- Building trust and credibility with prospects interested in financial education.

- Demonstrating a strong understanding of the offer, its value, and its target audience.

- Effectively navigating objections and helping prospects make informed purchasing decisions.

- Maintaining strong conversion rates and consistently achieving sales targets.

- Delivering an exceptional buyer experience from the first conversation through enrollment.

COMPENSATION & DETAILS

Estimated Annual Earnings: $90,000-$360,000

- Independent Contractor (1099)

- Performance-based compensation

- Flexible schedule

- Remote position

Experience Requirement: Previous high-ticket closing experience in financial education, stock market education, trading, investing, or wealth-building offers is strongly preferred and a key qualification for this opportunity.

The Head of Risk US will lead the US risk surface, owning all risk disciplines locally while maintaining close coordination with global functional heads: Global Credit Risk, the Global Market and Liquidity Head, and other risk domain leads.

The US risk team is in its early stages, with existing members covering Compliance, Financial Crime/AML, Regulatory, and is expected to grow in line with the business. This is a build-from-scratch opportunity for a senior executive who thrives in dynamic, high-growth environments.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Head of Risk US is a senior executive responsible for the effective and independent oversight of all risk disciplines within Nu's US operation.

- Apply Nu's "target friction" philosophy: prioritize controls based on materiality, avoiding uniform friction in favor of risk-proportionate management that enables business growth.

- Monitor operational loss events, cyber incidents, and key risk indicators, ensuring mitigation strategies are in place and effective.

Team & Stakeholder Leadership

- Lead and develop the US risk team, fostering a culture of high standards, intellectual rigor, and ownership.

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

You’ll join IT Hardware, Offices, working closely with IT Support, IT Workplace engineers, Workplace and suppliers. You’ll own recurring routines and resolve non-standard issues with minimal guidance, while using AI and automation to make everyday support faster, clearer and more consistent.

• Maintain and troubleshoot meeting-room AV, printers, signage and workstation setups, and support office moves, installations and events.

• Use approved AI tools in daily work to investigate technical issues, summarise ticket histories, check asset data and draft clear communication, verifying outputs before acting on them.

• Improve repetitive tasks with AI-assisted scripts, workflow rules or existing automation tools. Test changes, seek review where needed and check whether they reduce effort, errors or turnaround time.

title: Product Marketing Manager - Growth

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

About the Role

Access Control is one of Verkada's largest and fastest-growing businesses, and we're looking for a high-agency Product Marketing Manager to unlock its next phase of growth. You'll drive growth initiatives from idea to impact, identifying opportunities and turning them into measurable revenue.

This is a highly commercial role spanning the entire customer funnel. You’ll devise and execute strategies involving analyzing our customer base to find cross-sell opportunities, building targeted campaigns, creating sales plays, training the field, working directly with reps to activate accounts, and then measuring and improving pipeline and conversion.

Vem fazer beleza com a gente!

O que é nosso time de Tech Backoffice Franquias?
A Diretoria de Backoffice Franquias tem como missão alavancar a excelência operacional e os resultados da rede de franquias por meio de viabilização de produtos digitais que influenciem no fortalecimento do futuro e evolução das franquias. Buscamos uma pessoa inovadora em produto para liderar uma verdadeira revolução digital na nossa jornada de rotina da força de vendas: transformando ecossistemas físicos complexos em experiências simples, integradas e sem fricções. Seu objetivo será habilitar estratégias que apoiem a força de vendas na rotina de acompanhamento de resultados diários, eliminando a alta carga cognitiva e gerando mais autonomia. Você será responsável por traduzir dores reais identificadas através de dados e escuta ativa da força de vendas em oportunidades e soluções simples para que cada profissional possa priorizar atividades no dia a dia para melhorar sua performance individual. Se você tem paixão por arquiteturas escaláveis, ecossistemas autossustentáveis e quer construir o futuro da gestão do espaço físico com uso de inteligência artificial, essa oportunidade é para você.

- Definir a Visão e Estratégia do Produto: Construir e comunicar a visão de médio e longo prazo, conectando o roadmap técnico diretamente aos objetivos estratégicos do GB.

- Cultura e Mentoria: Elevar a barra técnica e comportamental do time, mentorando outros PMs, disseminando boas práticas de produto e estruturando processos de discovery e delivery.
- Liderança em Planejamento (PI Planning): Liderar a construção da estratégia dos ciclos de OKR e PI Planning, garantindo a integração e dependências entre múltiplos times e tribos.
- Estratégia de Growth e Ciclo de Vida: Olhar além da feature, desenhando estratégias para aumentar a adoção, retenção e o impacto do produto no ciclo de vida do franqueado/revendedor
O que você precisa ter ou saber?
- Senioridade em Gestão de Produto: Experiência sólida como Product Manager Sênior, liderando produtos com regras de negócio complexas (ex: produtos que habilitam indicadores de metas e acompanhamento de resultados, aplicação de IA para diagnóstico preditivo,..)

customer satisfaction), and use what the data shows to fix recurring issues at the root

• Strong working familiarity with procurement tools (e.g., Zip) and tools for managing online terms (e.g., Zendesk)

Job Description: International Humanitarian Law Advisor
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote
Commitment: Approximately 15 hours per week
About the Role
We are seeking experienced International Humanitarian Law (IHL) Advisors to contribute to a project focused on the rigorous application of international humanitarian law and human rights principles.
In this role, you will apply your legal expertise to support the training and evaluation of next-generation AI systems. You will help develop and assess complex legal scenarios involving lawful and unlawful conduct, civilian protection, proportionality, and legal reasoning.
Your expertise will help ensure that AI systems accurately interpret legal frameworks, recognize limitations, and handle complex legal uncertainties. Prior AI experience is not required.
Key Responsibilities

• Develop and create complex boundary-case scenarios involving international humanitarian law, civilian protection, proportionality, and prohibited conduct.

• Review and validate legal standards within project taxonomies to ensure alignment with current IHL and human rights frameworks.

• Evaluate AI-generated responses for legal accuracy, reasoning quality, and appropriate handling of legal uncertainty.

• Identify overly cautious refusals of legitimate queries and insufficient caution in situations involving civilian protection.

• Document and analyze complex legal scenarios from international humanitarian law and human rights perspectives.

• Collaborate with project teams to refine evaluation guidelines and maintain consistency in legal assessments.

• Provide clear, structured written and verbal feedback to support AI model development and evaluation.

Required Qualifications

• Recognized expertise in international humanitarian law and/or international human rights law.

• Strong knowledge of the Law of Armed Conflict (LOAC), human rights frameworks, and civilian protection standards.

• Professional experience as a legal practitioner, advisor, consultant, researcher, or scholar in relevant legal fields.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex legal concepts precisely.

• Demonstrated ability to document and analyze complex legal scenarios, including ambiguous cases and legal boundary issues.

• Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in advisory, consultancy, or teaching roles within international humanitarian law or human rights law.

• Operational advisory experience with organizations such as the ICRC, UN agencies, international tribunals, or commissions of inquiry.

• Familiarity with AI governance, AI evaluation, or technology-related legal assessment projects.

• Experience developing legal evaluation frameworks, guidelines, or assessment methodologies.

Selection Process

•
Application: Submit your profile and complete the role-specific screening questions.

•
AI Interview: Complete an interview with the AI recruiter.

•
Screening Survey: Complete a short survey covering your professional background, AI experience, and approach to a legal case scenario.

•
Profile Review: The team will evaluate your qualifications and survey responses.

•
Onboarding: Selected candidates will receive onboarding support from the Talent Operations team.
